title: Make Chimney Look Modern | Exterior Chimney Upgrade Ideas
description: Want to make your chimney look modern? See how this project transformed a plain exterior chimney using stone—no demolition or rebuilding required.
text:
How to Make a Chimney Look Modern Without Rebuilding It
See how this homeowner upgraded a plain exterior chimney into a clean, modern feature using stone—without tearing anything down.

Rob Dean

Senior Project Coordinator

Hi, I’m Rob, and I worked with this homeowner on updating their exterior chimney.

The chimney was structurally sound, but it stood out for the wrong reasons. The flat siding made it feel outdated and disconnected from the rest of the home.

They wanted a way to make the chimney look more modern—without rebuilding it or taking on a major renovation.

See What Your Home Could Look Like

A Simple Way to Make a Chimney Look Modern
Make Your Chimney Modern • Installs Over Existing Chimney Exterior

Instead of removing the existing concrete, we installed stone veneer directly over it—creating a finished, built-in look for the entry.

✅ Installed directly over brick

✅ No demolition required

✅ Adds depth and visual interest

✅ Completed in days, not weeks

A Complete Chimney Upgrade Without Rebuilding
A simple upgrade turned this builder-grade exterior into a clean, custom look adding depth, contrast, and a high-end finish without major construction.

Before

The Goal

- Plain siding chimney lacked character

- Looked outdated compared to the rest of the home

- Stood out in a negative way

- No depth or architectural detail

After

The Solution

- Cover the chimney with stone veneer

- Create a modern, finished look

- Add texture and contrast

- Turn the chimney into a focal point

What Does It Cost to Make a Chimney Look Modern?

Projects like this typically range between $3,000–$10,000, depending on the height and layout of the chimney. Updating the surface is often far more affordable than rebuilding—and much faster to complete.

Project Details

- Products Used: Panels, Corners

- Color: Kenai

- Install: Over Existing Brick

Can stone be installed over an existing chimney?

Yes, GenStone can be installed over any flat surface as long as the substrate is structural. To install over concrete, brick or stucco we recommend using Tapcon screws and construction adhesive. For all other substrates, deck screws are the recommended fastener.

Can you make a chimney look modern without rebuilding it?

Yes, resurfacing your chimney with GenStone is an easy way to make your chimney look brand new and modern without any demo work.

Does this work on siding or wood chimneys?

GenStone can be installed over any flat, sturdy surface.

How long does it take to update a chimney like this?

GenStone is as simple as measure, cut and attach. A chimney like the one featured in this article would take two people about a day and one person no longer than two days to complete.

Kenai Color Guide

Kenai was chosen to give the chimney a clean, modern stone appearance that contrasts the siding and adds depth to the exterior.
